items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: And Trapania on bass drumming you on.

ctx.x: Taton played baritone? Yeah, it was baritone, but I had to. Because that's, that's God, man. And Trapania on bass drumming you on.
Yeah, Trapania on bass drumming you on.
And I was on snare. Well, after Trapania got out, who, who, who played snare then? You switched to bass?
